description: Ask before acting. Judges a proposed action (a command, a message about to be sent, a purchase, a change, anything) against the rules this person has asked their Ai to keep, plus the NEVER and MUST lines of the project intent. Returns allow, ask or deny with the rule that applies. The shell hook does this automatically for commands; call this for everything else, and always before an action that is hard to undo. Fails open: an error is an allow with judged=false.

action.description: The action you intend to take, in plain words or as the exact command or message

context.description: Why you want to do it, or what the person asked for

kind.description: What sort of thing the action is (default: action)

name: guard_check
